bribability.translation:
n. 有贿赂的可能, 易受贿
[法] 受贿的可能性, 被收买的可能性

bribable.translation: a. 可贿赂的, 可收买的

bribe.definition:
n. payment made to a person in a position of trust to corrupt his judgment
v. make illegal payments to in exchange for favors or influence
bribe.translation:
n. 贿赂
vt. 贿赂, 收买
vi. 行贿

bribeable.translation: a. 可贿赂的, 可收买的

bribed.translation: v. 贿赂( bribe的过去式和过去分词 ); 向（某人）行贿, 贿赂

bribee.translation:
n. 受贿者
[法] 受贿者

briber.definition: n. someone who pays (or otherwise incites) you to commit a wrongful act
briber.translation:
n. 行贿者
[经] 行贿者

briberies.translation: n. 行贿, 受贿, 贿赂( bribery的名词复数 )

bribers.translation: 行贿者( briber的名词复数 )

bribery.definition: n. the practice of offering something (usually money) in order to gain an illicit advantage
bribery.translation:
n. 贿赂行为, 行贿, 受贿
[经] 行贿, 受贿

bribes.definition:
n payment made to a person in a position of trust to corrupt his judgment
v make illegal payments to in exchange for favors or influence

bribing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Bribe
bribing.translation: v. 贿赂( bribe的现在分词 ); 向（某人）行贿, 贿赂
